node.title: Re: Writing to an output file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I would recommend you read through [doc://perlintro], it's not very long and it shows how to do basic file I/O, for example:

my $filename = "output.txt"; open my $fh, '>', $filename or die "$filename: $!"; print $fh "Hello"; close $fh;
